description: This Java test class sets up a benchmark scenario for parsing JSON payloads into Ditto protocol messages using a JavaScript-based message mapper. It contains static JSON mapping data, JavaScript mapping scripts, and methods to initialize external messages and configure the mapper.

classes.name: Test2ParseJsonPayloadToDitto
classes.description: A benchmarking class that implements MapToDittoProtocolScenario, used for testing JSON payload parsing into Ditto protocol messages.

methods.name: getMessageMapper
methods.description: Configures and returns a JavaScript message mapper instance for the benchmarking scenario.

methods.name: getExternalMessage
methods.description: Returns the externally configured sample message containing JSON payload data.
